capture.reference: each section's windows[0].states from the hash-bound EXP-480 dop853-refined result
capture.initial_on_plane: flag t=0, exclude its root only, do not exclude seed

sample.pair_rule: first true consecutive accepted-return pair whose source is in each half-open physical-time stratum and target is at or before the window end
sample.unresolved_rule: exclude seed with any unresolved root or sliding-plane ambiguity; never bridge unresolved events
sample.population: valid and unambiguous through t=300, uncaptured on both sections, sufficient pairs in every section/window/stratum, then intersect retained global IDs across both RK4 profiles
sample.weights: exactly four pairs per seed per window per section; equal seed weights; no interpolation, duplication or refill

analysis.baseline: calibration-only least-squares affine map; report heldout q90 error beside spline on identical supported rows; no additional gate
analysis.normalization: min and max of all calibration pair endpoints only, same affine transform for source and target; no holdout refit
analysis.joint_primary_gate: all five variants, both windows and both step profiles resolve in each case; branch count agrees; ordered critical regions must be disjoint within and across maps, and matched intervals across windows/profiles span at most 0.04 of their combined calibration domain
analysis.across_cases: report both cases separately; do not pool or select the better case; overall support requires both
analysis.uncertainty: whole calibration-seed bootstrap; failed replicates retained; envelope over nominal and count-matched bootstrap extrema and all variants; descriptive, not a simultaneous confidence interval

critical_membership.reference_orbit: all six historical events from the same hash-bound EXP-480 window; no chosen phase
critical_membership.report: full orbit-event by ordered critical-region distance/slope matrix; zero, one or multiple near-critical events; no rounding to criticality
critical_membership.permitted_claim: finite-resolution proximity to independently estimated turning regions, conditional on nominated cases and retained finite-time population

adaptive_qualification.scope: early transient event-detection/numerical diagnostic only; no long-time shadowing or all-root guarantee

resources.backend: local CPU Float64, serial fixed batches
resources.resource_bound_semantics: RSS and disk are sampled operational stop thresholds, not kernel-enforced peak quotas; queries and writes may overshoot between samples. Per-snapshot and per-batch bounds also apply. Worker parent-loss/deadline guard must be installed and attested before scientific imports.
resources.failure_policy: retain raw and partial evidence, stop campaign on technical invalidity or cap; do not retry or analyze an incomplete campaign as completed

not_yet_implemented: source/input/review-bound production CLI, canonical runtime environment and isolated import closure, complete trial/both-case aggregation
full production startup preflight and compact adjudicated review
claim_scope: Unreviewed numeric proposal only. New deterministic seed coordinates are inputs, not trajectories. No target computation or manuscript claim is authorized.
